checks_run.procedure: Adversarial probe for any remaining undeclared-media-type, rewrite, undeclared-status or 500 path. It covers Content-Type case, parameter, whitespace, list, wildcard and +json variants; duplicate headers on a real socket; an absent Content-Type with a body; logout and activate (D-069 b); DELETE, OPTIONS and PUT with bodies; GET/HEAD bodies and smuggling (D-069 a); rate-limit precedence; a socket repro; a U+FFFD sweep; unmatched routes; and the refusal detail
checks_run.command: zz-sec-r9-probe.test.ts S1-S11 (same runs as SEC-R9-01) + baseline: with-pg.sh 29883 pnpm vitest run ... zz-sec-r9-probe.test.ts -t S1[01] in $TMPDIR/probe-r8base (cf3446e4)
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2; disposable clones at 041478cb and cf3446e4; disposable PostgreSQL 16 in both locale settings
checks_run.expected: No undeclared media type is accepted, nothing is stored rewritten, there is no 500 and no undeclared status, and an unmatched route answers 404 whatever the media type
checks_run.actual: S1-S9 pass in both runs. Accepted variants store byte-exact; every other variant gives the declared 400 and stores nothing. Duplicate headers resolve consistently. GET bodies are never read and smuggling fails. Results under a 3/min limit: 400 400 400 429 429. 0 U+FFFD, 0 error logs. Two Low residuals. S10: an unmatched route with application/octet-stream gives 400 validation.content_type instead of 404, where it gave 404 at cf3446e4 (F-DG2-350). S11: 'application/octet-stream\t; x=1' on the upload gives the declared 400 but a detail naming application/json, the same as at cf3446e4 (F-DG2-351). The probe exits 1 by design: S10 and S11 encode the expected behaviour.

checks_run.procedure: Source review of the product diff cf3446e4..7854770e (media-types.ts, server.ts, evidence/routes.ts, platform/index.ts, hooks.ts mapping; FE8 problem.ts, RecordForm.tsx, JourneysSection.tsx) against fastify 5.6.1 handleRequest.js and contentTypeParser.js, plus an added-line scan for risky patterns
checks_run.command: git diff cf3446e4..7854770e -- . ':!docs/delivery'; grep of added lines (diff-scan.log); read node_modules/.pnpm/fastify@5.6.1/.../lib/{handleRequest,contentTypeParser}.js
checks_run.expected: No weakening of bodyLimit, the strict UTF-8 JSON parser, prototype-poisoning protection, CSRF, authorization, the 25 MiB streaming limit or the raw-byte sha256. FE8 drops no distinct message and leaks no internals. No secrets, CDNs or eval.
checks_run.actual: BE14. The JSON parser is still parseAs buffer, then createJsonBodyParser, then getDefaultJsonParser('error','error'), wrapped by restrictParserTo, so bodyLimit, strict UTF-8 and proto protection are unchanged. The octet parser still hands the raw stream to the handler. isRawByteBody refuses parsed values and encoded streams. The size limit and sha256 are untouched. preParsing precedes preValidation authentication and CSRF, as framework parse errors always have. willParseBody matches fastify 5.6.1, which has no OPTIONS exception. Gaps: restrictParserTo lacks the is404 skip (F-DG2-350), and hooks.ts:66-67 keeps a JSON-only detail for FST_ERR_CTP_INVALID_MEDIA_TYPE (F-DG2-351). FE8. distinctFormMessages removes only messages identical to the banner or repeated; distinct messages stay in order; all messages are i18n strings from problem codes (no title/detail/internals); the JourneysSection guard hides only an identical text. The scan found no matches.

summary: PASS. F-DG2-320 is CLOSED_VERIFIED: my round-8 repro (R6) now passes in both locales, and so does a real-socket rerun. A probe across eleven areas found no operation that accepts an undeclared media type, no rewritten body, no 500 and no undeclared status on any declared operation. BE14 does not weaken bodyLimit, the strict UTF-8 parser, prototype-poisoning protection, CSRF, authorization, the 25 MiB streaming limit or the raw-byte sha256. Rate limiting still precedes the refusal. I agree with both D-069 design choices. FE8 drops only identical messages and leaks no internals. All required checks ran and passed: build, typecheck, lint, openapi-lint (161), no-cdn, format; unit 718/718 on Node 22 and 24 and under load; integration 559/559 in both locales, with 19 migrations; the AUD-403 sweep; historical DG0/DG1. Two new Low, non-mandatory findings. F-DG2-350: an unmatched route given an octet-stream body answers 400 instead of 404 (a BE14 regression in restrictParserTo). F-DG2-351: a tab before ';' in an octet-stream Content-Type gets the declared 400 with a detail naming application/json (this predates BE14). No Critical, High or mandatory issue is unresolved.
